annotations.title: Tokenized stocks across issuers and networks

description: Tokenized stocks on chain, one row per company across every issuer and network we read (Coinbase on Base; Robinhood on Robinhood Chain; xStocks on Solana, Ethereum, Arbitrum, BNB Chain, TON, Tron and others; Ondo on Ethereum, BNB Chain, Solana, HyperEVM and Robinhood Chain; bStocks (Binance) on BNB Chain; Dinari on Arbitrum, Ethereum and Base). A question resolves to the underlying first (ISIN, token symbol, plain ticker, a word of the name) and takes every token of that ISIN; look-alikes come back apart in `approximate`, never in the totals. Free. Each company carries its networks, issuers and tokens, and what is in issue at each issuer’s own reference value summed over networks (valueComplete false where a token has no reference value, so the sum is a floor). Supply is read on chain except for Coinbase, where it is the issuer’s. A company or network missing here is one we have not read, not one without tokenized stocks. We monitor; we issue nothing.

chain.description: Optional. One network: base, robinhood, solana, ethereum, arbitrum, bnb, optimism, hyperevm, monad, mantle, ink, xlayer, ton, tron.

kind.description: Only shares, ETFs or funds, estimated from the instrument name (issuers publish no class we read).

limit.description: Optional. Rows of `companies` and `items` to return (default 25 here).

q.description: Optional. An ISIN, a token symbol (SPYon), the plain ticker of the underlying (SPY) or a word of its name (SpaceX).

name: find_stocks

approximate.description: Look-alike companies (a ticker beginning with the question, or a name containing it when nothing matched exactly). Not the instrument asked for and not counted in total or valuedUsd.

companies.description: One per company (grouped on ISIN): `name`, `isin`, `networks`, `issuers`, `tokens` (chain, address, symbol, issuer, valueUsd, page), `valueUsd`, `valueComplete`, `valueMeans`.

coverage.description: Which issuers and networks were read; anything outside it is unread, not absent.

items.description: One per token deployment, largest first: chain, address, issuer, symbol, name, isin, supply, `referenceValue` {usd, asOf, source, means}, valueUsd, control, market, page.

matchedAs.description: How the question matched: isin, token, ticker, name or approximate (absent without q).

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

minted.description: Of those, how many have supply in issue.

returned.description: Rows of `items` sent, after the limit.

total.description: Token deployments matching the question, before the limit.

valued.description: Tokens that carry a reference value; the rest have no dollar figure, not zero.

valuedUsd.description: What is in issue at reference value, summed over tokens that carry one.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

title: Tokenized stocks across issuers and networks
